name: Onii-chan to Issho
original_name: おにいちゃんといっしょ
source:
Toyoda Shinji lives with his father, a teacher at school. Shinji was enjoying his school life till one of his classmates became his sister. She started to live under the same roof and from that day peaceful life went awry...
